title: VidWeave
tagline: VidWeave: Empowering decentralized video messaging and screen recording. Seamlessly communicate and collaborate with others through encrypted, peer-to-peer video sharing. Take control of your data and privacy while revolutionizing the way we connect and create.
description:
Join Vidweave, the revolutionary decentralized platform, at the Hackathon and be a part of transforming the way screen recording and collaboration work. Vidweave empowers users to create, share, and store screen recordings securely while ensuring privacy and data ownership.

With our innovative integration of Filecoin Lighthouse, your recordings are permanently stored using blockchain technology. Say goodbye to worries about data loss or manipulation. Vidweave also leverages Tableland, a decentralized database, to store user data, ensuring complete control over your information.

What sets Vidweave apart is its gasless multichain architecture, eliminating transaction fees and making it a cost-effective solution for users. Our subscription plans are more affordable than traditional Web 2.0 platforms, making Vidweave accessible to all.

But that's not all! We have exciting plans in the pipeline, including web camera-based recording, live video transcription, and editing tools, providing users with an all-in-one creative platform.

Collaboration is key, and Vidweave knows it. We incorporate decentralized push notifications and chat using Push Chat, enabling real-time collaboration and seamless communication among team members.

We've got hosting covered too! Vidweave is deployed on Spherhon, a decentralized hosting platform that ensures high availability, scalability, and security.

Join us at the Hackathon and become a part of the Vidweave movement. We're revolutionizing screen recording and collaboration, providing users with unparalleled privacy, security, and affordability. Let's reshape the future of digital collaboration together!

Sign up for Vidweave today and unlock a new era of decentralized screen recording and collaboration. Visit our website for more details and be prepared to be amazed!
how_its_made:
Vidweave, the groundbreaking decentralized platform for screen recording and collaboration, is built using cutting-edge technologies to provide a seamless and secure experience for users. Here's a glimpse into how Vidweave is made:

Decentralized Storage:
Vidweave leverages the power of Filecoin Lighthouse, a decentralized storage solution powered by blockchain technology. This ensures that screen recordings are securely stored and accessible from anywhere, anytime, without the risk of data loss or manipulation.

Secure Data Management:
To give users complete control over their data, Vidweave utilizes Tableland, a decentralized database. User data, including recordings and workspace interactions, is securely stored on Tableland, ensuring privacy, security, and ownership of information.

Multichain Gasless Platform:
Vidweave eliminates the burden of transaction fees by implementing a multichain gasless architecture. This ensures that users can focus on creating and collaborating without worrying about additional costs. Our subscription-based plans are more affordable than traditional Web 2.0 platforms, making Vidweave accessible to a wide range of users.

Advanced Features:
Vidweave's commitment to innovation extends beyond screen recording. We are constantly working on integrating web camera-based recording and live video transcription and editing tools, providing users with enhanced versatility and creative options.

Decentralized Collaboration:
Collaboration is a core component of Vidweave. We have implemented decentralized push notifications and chat using Push Chat, enabling real-time collaboration and seamless communication among team members. This ensures that everyone stays in sync and can collaborate effectively.

Secure Hosting:
Vidweave is deployed on Spherhon, a decentralized hosting platform that guarantees high availability, scalability, and security. This ensures a reliable and secure infrastructure for users to access the platform and their recordings.
